boundary.role: the trigger: return smc.aux.ESS < smc.N * smc.ESSrmin
ESSrmin default 0.5; resampling scheme name default 'systematic'; N default 100
rs_flag = fk.time_to_resample(self); if set, A = rs.resampling(scheme, aux.W, M=N), Xp = X[A], weights reset; else A = identity; then X = M(t, Xp)
loglt = log mean weight if rs_flag or t == 0 else the difference of consecutive log mean weights; logLt accumulates
ESS = (sum w)^2 / sum w^2 from log-weights, max-subtracted
the three classical schemes as ordered-uniform draws over one inverse-CDF pass (inverse_cdf at 485-510)

mechanism_claim.functional_claim: Within the SMC loop, whether the particle population is resampled at step t is decided by exactly one predicate -- ESS(aux weights) < N * ESSrmin, evaluated at core.py:181-183 and consumed at core.py:326-338 -- and resampling is the only operation that counteracts weight degeneracy. Consequently: (a) with ESSrmin = 0 the loop never resamples and the log-likelihood estimate logLt and the filtering means degrade with T; (b) with ESSrmin = 1 the loop resamples at every step t >= 1 whose weights are non-uniform; (c) with the trigger fixed, the variance of logLt is ordered by scheme, multinomial above systematic.
mechanism_claim.claimed_inputs: log-weights (from logG), N, ESSrmin, the scheme name
mechanism_claim.claimed_outputs: rs_flag per step; the ancestor vector A; the reset of the weights; through them logLt and the particle approximation of the filtering distribution
mechanism_claim.claimed_internal_dependency: time_to_resample reads aux.ESS (essl over the current log-weights, or the APF-adjusted ones); resample_move reads rs_flag and the scheme registry; compute_summaries reads rs_flag to choose the loglt form; no other CODE line in core.py reads ESS or ESSrmin (grep 2026-09-17 on payload 1c99eb98...: code sites 183, 264, 274; 212-217 are docstring)
mechanism_claim.known_uncertainty: the SIZE of the multinomial-vs-systematic variance gap at N = 100, T = 100 on the chosen model (theory orders them; the packet's band is wide); whether numba's JIT of inverse_cdf/ssp is available on the adjudicating host (it is on M3 as of the SCOUT import); the model-level default ESSrmin lives in SMC.__init__, not in the model class -- the cut's residue said 'not read', this packet corrects that: it is 0.5 at core.py:264
